Are TCB's acne treatment reviews good? Explanation of bad reviews, fees, and treatment details

“Can we expect improvement with TCB acne treatment?”

“How much does it cost?”

Many people may have questions like the ones above.

TCB's acne treatment isderma penWe have multiple treatment menus, including oral medication sets, and can treat a wide range of concerns, from active acne to crater scars.

The reviews you see on review sites and SNS vary depending on the treatment you received and the condition of your skin.

In addition to points to consider when checking reviews,Estimated treatment fee and total amount that can be confirmed on TCB official websiteI will explain.

In addition, active acne, acne scars, craters, etc.Treatments that are suitable and unsuitable for each type of problemWe have organized the information and also posted price comparisons with other clinics such as Shonan Beauty Clinic.

Please use this as a reference to determine whether TCB treatment is suitable for your concerns.

What you can learn from this article
  • Points to check the reviews and reputation of TCB acne treatment
  • Features of Dermapen, Subcision, and Oral Medicine Set by treatment
Supervisor of this article

Yoshitomo Chihara

Director of Norris Beauty Clinic

Postdoctoral Researcher, Norris Cancer Center, University of Southern California;National Cancer Center PathologyHead of the club,Nara Prefectural Medical UniversityLecturer in Molecular Pathology,Saiseikai Chuwa HospitalAfter serving as head of the urology departmentnorris beauty clinicOpened a hospital.

Norris Beauty Clinic’s content production policy regarding aesthetic medicine

Norris Beauty Clinic operates with the aim of disseminating accurate and easy-to-understand information to our readers about aesthetic medicine, such as medical diets (GLP-1 receptor agonists, fat freezing, fat-dissolving injections, liposuction, etc.) and double plastic surgery.

Cosmetic treatments such as medical diets and double plastic surgery are important themes that are closely related to each individual's health condition, constitution, cost, and schedule.

We create content with an emphasis on reliability, neutrality, and safety so that our readers can calmly make choices that are suitable for them and prepare for advance counseling.

■Basic policy for content production

■Production flow

At our media, we create content through the following process.

Production flow
  1. Search needs/concerns survey
  2. Configuration design (organizing comparison standards and points to note)
  3. Writing/editing/fact checking
  4. Regular updates to the latest prices and medical system

■Regarding reliability of information

When writing articles, we use the following public institutions and highly reliable information sources.

An example of reference data for this media
  • Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare(Medical advertising guidelines/Pharmaceuticals Act related information)
  • PMDA (Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency)
  • Japan Obesity Society・Japanese Society of Aesthetic Surgery (JSAS)Related academic societies such as
  • Consumer Affairs Agency(Related to the Specified Commercial Transactions Act and the Act on Premiums and Representations)
  • Official website information of each medical institution/pharmaceutical company

In addition, we regularly review information in response to price revisions, changes in clinic hours, updated guidelines, etc.

■Commitment to neutrality and transparency

Guaranteeing neutrality and objectivity
  • Specifies not only the benefits of each treatment but also side effects, risks, and downtime.
  • Presents points to note regarding total costs and cancellation regulations (cooling-off, etc.) for free medical treatment.
  • Do not use definitive expressions such as ``always'' or ``absolutely'' regarding changes or progress that vary from person to person.
  • Information is posted based on objective facts regardless of whether there is a partnership or not.

For detailed management structure and editorial stance, please seeNorris Beauty Clinic’s content production policy regarding aesthetic medicinePlease check.

Points to keep in mind when checking reviews and reputation of TCB acne treatment

When looking at the reputation of TCB's acne treatment, it is important to check conditions such as the treatment received and the number of hospital visits.

Three aspects to check reviews: effectiveness, customer service, number of treatments
  • Points to check for good reviews regarding skin changes
  • Points to check regarding reviews regarding counseling and solicitation
  • How do you read “no effect” posts on Chiebukuro and SNS?

Posts on SNS and review sites are the impressions of those who have experienced the product, and do not guarantee that you will get the same results.

Therefore, to get the full picture,Separate and check positive and negative evaluationsIt is essential to do so.

Below, we will explain the points to look at when checking evaluations from three perspectives: effectiveness, customer service, and number of treatments.

Pay attention to whether the person receiving the treatment has the same background as you and the specificity of the information.

Points to check for good reviews regarding skin changes

When considering the effectiveness of acne treatment, consider using dermapen, oral medications, etc.What treatment did you receive?Let's check.

Even if the photos and progress in the post are helpful, please note that the shooting conditions and treatment details are different.

Regarding oral medications, the type of prescribed drug, period of use, and presence or absence of side effects are important.

Because there are individual differences in the time when symptoms change,2-3 monthsEffects cannot be determined based on the period alone.

Three points to judge reviews
  • Pre-treatment skin condition and treatment details are explained.
  • You can specifically check the treatments/prescribed drugs and number of times performed.
  • It also touches on the adaptation of treatments to symptoms and side effects.

Check the skin condition before the treatment and the combination of treatments, even if they read reviews that explain changes in your skin.

The indications for the treatment vary depending on the condition of your skin, so it is important to make a decision based on your doctor's examination.

The indications for Dermapen and oral medication sets differ depending on whether you are treating active acne or acne scars.

Since it is not guaranteed that you will get the changes you expect after one treatment, be sure to check the required number of treatments and side effects in advance.

If you are offered multiple treatments, consider the medical necessity and total cost before making a decision.

Points to check regarding reviews regarding counseling and solicitation

When reading reviews about counseling, be sure to check if the proposal and cost are explained in detail.

With TCB counseling, it is possible to decline a treatment proposal.

If you tell the client before the counseling session that you will just consider it and go home today, it will be easier to decline future proposals.

Tips on how to refuse on the day of counseling
  • Before starting, say, ``I'll just do some research today and go home.''
  • Even if you are asked to make a decision on the same day, reply, “I will take it home and consider it.”
  • If you are not compatible with the person in charge, request a change.
  • Cooling-off may be possible for contracts that meet the specified period, amount, treatment details, etc.

Even if you are rushed into signing a contract through counseling, there is no need to decide on the spot.

During the consultation, check the necessity, fees, and cancellation conditions of the proposed treatment and make a decision.

Another way to calmly decide is to decide in advance that you won't rush into a contract.

If you feel that you are not compatible with the counselor in charge, one option is to request a change in counselor.

How do you read “no effect” posts on Chiebukuro and SNS?

Before using posts on Yahoo! Chiebukuro or X (formerly Twitter) as a reference, check the treatment name, timing, and number of treatments.

What you want to know when reading these posts is:Which treatment did you undergo and how many times?This is the information.

You may not notice the effect after one treatment, but it does not necessarily mean that you will get better if you repeat the treatment several times.

3 points to check when reading “no effect” reviews
  • What treatment did you receive (Dermapen, peeling, oral medication, etc.)
  • How many times have you received the treatment? (It may be too early to judge if the evaluation is done only once.)
  • Did the type of problem match the type of treatment?

Dermapen and peeling treatments may be recommended multiple times depending on the condition of your skin.

If you have inflammatory acne, the applicability of treatments for acne scars may be limited.

The effects may vary from person to person, so please check with your doctor to see if the treatment is suitable for your symptoms.

When you see a post that says “no effect”,Treatment type, number of treatments, and elapsed periodLet's check together.

Whether TCB acne treatment is suitable for you depends on the type of problem and the combination of treatments.

Please check your skin condition during your consultation before proceeding with your treatment selection.

Check the official price and applicable conditions for TCB acne treatment

Distinguish between free counseling and paid treatments, and check the applicable conditions and total payment amount before visiting the clinic.

Options for TCB include oral medication and dermapen, but the required treatment and frequency will vary depending on the skin condition.

According to the official price list, the acne oral medication set costs 4,590 yen (tax included), and the Dermapen 4 facial for one time costs 19,800 yen (tax included).

If multiple treatments or a combination of drugs are recommended during your consultation, please check the total price for each treatment in addition to the unit price for each menu.

The cost may change depending on the addition of anesthesia or drugs, changes in the scope of treatment, etc.

Also, when considering a course contract, it will be easier to make a decision if you check how to settle the contract in the event of mid-term cancellation and how the untreated portion will be handled.

There is no need to contract for the treatment on the same day you receive the free consultation, so if you are not satisfied with the contents, take the estimates home and compare them.

When choosing a treatment, consider not only the price, but also its suitability for your skin condition and explanation of side effects, and consult with your doctor.

Estimated total cost for continuous treatment

If continuing treatment is required, the total amount will vary depending on the type of treatment, number of times, and drug prescription.

Officially published acne medication set4,590 yenAssuming you bought 3 times, the total is13,770 yenIt is.

Dermapen 4 face once19,800 yenSo, the official face 5-time course is79,000 yen, the 10-session course is148,500 yenIt is.

If you are considering multiple treatments,Single fee and official 5/10 lesson feeLet's compare.

*The following is an example of calculation using single-time charges, and does not indicate the actual treatment plan or number of drug prescriptions.

TCB's Dermapen 4 guide indicates that the treatment interval is about one and a half to two months.

The amounts listed in the table do not imply monthly hospital visits; please check with your doctor regarding the indications, intervals, and combinations of treatments.

If you are planning to use multiple treatments at the same time, please check with your doctor about the indications and number of treatments and ask them to give you a quote.

Be specific about your budget and check the treatments you can choose within that range and the number of treatments required.

Specific steps to take when refusing to be guided to a high-priced plan

When an expensive plan is proposed during counseling,Don't make a decision on the spot; take it home and consider it.is an option.

Even if a treatment is suggested during TCB counseling, there is no obligation to sign a contract on the spot.

Preparation checklist for turning down expensive plans
  • Begin by saying, ``Today I'm just gathering information.''
  • Decide your budget limit in advance
  • Decide not to make a decision on the spot.
  • Be aware that the applicability of cooling-off varies depending on the contract details.
  • If you are concerned about the response of the person in charge, ask for explanation or change of person in charge.

Eligible aesthetic medical care contractsIf the contract period exceeds one month and the total amount exceeds 50,000 yen, etc., cooling-off can be done within 8 days from the date of receipt of the legal document.

If you are unsure how to decline the offer, it is best to start by saying, ``I'm here today just to gather information,'' which will make it easier for the person in charge to adjust the strength of your proposal.

If you feel that you are still being solicited, consider requesting a change of contact person or switching to another clinic.

Just because you don't sign a contract on the day of counseling, your application at a later date will not be declined, so don't rush into making a decision.

TCB's acne treatment menu and characteristics of each treatment

TCB's acne treatment isType and severity of worriesThe treatment you should choose will depend on your condition.

The appropriate approach will vary depending on whether your priority is to suppress the inflammation of active acne or if you want to improve the crater scars that have formed.

Characteristics, suitability and unsuitability of TCB acne treatment 3 treatments
  • Dermapen approaches enlarged pores and uneven acne scars.
  • Subcision differs in its adaptation depending on the shape of the crater.
  • Oral medication set is a treatment option for recurring acne

When reading the evaluation, make sure that the treatment purpose matches the indication for the treatment you received.

TCB's acne-related menu includes:Dermapen 4/Subcision/Acne Oral SetTreatment indications vary depending on the symptoms.

After sorting out the type of problem you are having, check the characteristics and precautions of each treatment below.

Dermapen approaches enlarged pores and uneven acne scars.

Dermapen is a treatment that utilizes the skin's repair process by making small holes in the skin with fine needles.

It promotes the production of collagen and other substances during the skin repair process, aiming to improve enlarged pores and uneven acne scars.

It is not possible to determine improvement with a specific number of treatments, and the number of necessary treatments varies from person to person.

Suitable and unsuitable derma pens
  • [Symptoms to be considered] Open pores and uneven acne scars
  • [Not suitable] Active acne with residual inflammation (treatment may not be possible)
  • [Recommended number of times] Depending on the symptoms, multiple times may be necessary.
  • [Downtime] Redness and swelling may last for several days to a week

Even if you don't notice a change after just one treatment, the reason cannot be limited to the number of treatments.

Dermapen may require multiple treatments depending on the symptoms, but results are not guaranteed.

You may not be able to undergo treatment if you have active acne that remains inflamed.

Be honest about your skin condition during your consultation.

Symptoms such as redness from Dermapen may last from a few days to a week, so be sure to schedule your treatment with plenty of time in your schedule.

If you are concerned about enlarged pores or uneven acne scars, please check the detailed Dermapen frequency plan during your consultation.

Subcision differs in its adaptation depending on the shape of the crater.

Subcision is a treatment that uses a needle to cut away the fibrous tissue that pulls the skin under acne scars, aiming to improve the unevenness.

Subcision is an option for retracted craters, but other treatments may be appropriate depending on the shape.

Subcision results vary depending on the shape and depth of the crater, so ask your doctor about the changes you can expect and the risks.

Subcision is a craterdepth and shapeAdaptation varies depending on the

Crater type and suitability of treatment
  • [Possible indication] Rolling type unevenness with retraction by fibers
  • [Other treatments may be required] Box-shaped or ice-pick-shaped irregularities
  • [Combination treatment] Applicability determined by doctor's examination
  • [Downtime] Please plan ahead as internal bleeding may continue for 1 to 2 weeks.

The suitable treatments differ depending on the shape, such as rolling type, box type, or ice pick type.

Whether Subcision and Dermapen are suitable for use together depends on the shape of the crater and the condition of your skin.

Internal bleeding may occur after the procedure, and it may take some time before it disappears.1-2 weeksThere are cases where this happens.

Be careful about the timing of your treatment before a photo shoot or important event, and make reservations with plenty of time in your schedule.

Oral medication set is a treatment option for recurring acne

TCB's oral acne treatment set is an option for oral treatment depending on your skin condition.

With oral medications, there is usually no downtime such as redness of the skin due to the procedure, but side effects may occur.

The effects and side effects of oral medications vary from person to person, and it is not possible to compare experiences without checking the prescription details.

Positioning and precautions of oral medicine set
  • [Purpose] Doctors consider oral treatment depending on symptoms
  • [Limitations] It is difficult to improve pitted acne scars with oral medications alone.
  • [Points to note] While there is no downtime with the procedure, there may be side effects such as nausea and gastrointestinal symptoms.
  • [Cost] Acne oral medication set is 4,590 yen including tax (official listed price)

However, it is not possible to improve existing craters with oral medications alone without using topical medications or treatments.

The role of prescription drugs differs depending on the type of drug, so consult your doctor about whether or not they can prevent recurrence.

Oral medications require a doctor's prescription, so avoid adjusting or stopping the dosage on your own.

If your symptoms change, tell your doctor at your next visit.

In terms of costs, monthly drug costs continue to occur,Total cost assuming long-term usePlease check this at the time of counseling.

If you are considering taking oral medication, please consult your doctor, including treatment that can be received at a dermatologist covered by insurance.

Pros and cons of TCB acne treatment by problem

TCB's acne treatment depends on the type of problem.Suitable treatments and unsuitable treatmentsare clearly separated.

The treatment objectives, medicines, and treatments used are different for active acne and uneven acne scars.

By type of problem: suitable/unsuitable for TCB acne treatment
  • For active acne, a combination of internal and external medications to suppress inflammation is the main treatment.
  • Dermapen and Subcision are often chosen for acne scars and craters.
  • Care must be taken when choosing treatment for excessive sebum, which is unique to male acne.

Before undergoing treatment, ask your doctor to check your skin condition and compare the expected effects, risks, and costs.

The reason why a treatment is rated as ``ineffective'' by word of mouth cannot be determined solely by compatibility with the treatment.

Please explain your concerns specifically during the counseling session and check which treatment is suitable for you before choosing a treatment.

For active acne, a combination of internal and external medications to suppress inflammation is the main treatment.

For active acne, treatment with topical or oral medications will be considered depending on the symptoms.

According to TCB's official price list,Differingel Dalacin AdapaleneTopical medications such as these can be confirmed, but the actual prescription will be determined by a medical examination.

If you receive a treatment that uses physical stimulation such as Dermapen when inflammation remains, there is a risk that the symptoms will worsen.

At the stage where there are multiple inflammatory pimples with redness and pus, lasers and Dermapen may not be indicated.

It is important to be honest about your current skin condition during your consultation.

Treatments using internal and external drugs overlap in some respects with those provided by dermatologists covered by health insurance.

At TCB's free medical treatment, we select drugs and treatments after confirming the necessity through a medical examination.

TCB official acne oral medication set4,590 yen (tax included)Therefore, please consult with us regarding the type of medicine and the required period, including insurance treatment options.

Dermapen and Subcision are often chosen for acne scars and craters.

Treatments such as dermapen and subcision are candidates for uneven acne scars.

Dermapen is a treatment that aims to improve the unevenness of acne scars by making small needle holes in the skin and using the repair process.

TCB's Dermapen 4 is used once on the face19,800 yenMultiple courses are also available.

Subcision is a treatment that uses a needle to cut the fibrous tissue beneath the acne scars, aiming to improve the unevenness of the skin.
